description: Reopen a closed issue; the comment, if any, is posted as it reopens, and the people following the issue are notified. An issue that is open already is left as it is: nothing is sent, the comment is not posted and changed is false. An issue is 12, #12, owner/repo#12 or its URL; a bare number means the working tree's repository, or repo.

comment.description: A comment to post as the issue reopens.

issue.description: The issue, as 12, #12, owner/repo#12 or its URL.

repo.description: owner/name; defaults to the working tree's repository (its origin). Used for a bare number.

name: github_issue_reopen

changed.description: False when the issue was open already and nothing was sent.

title: Reopen a GitHub issue
